description.player_sees: You stayed with Jiří through the night. You heard his story. The locals know.
description.bros_see: That transit guy really appreciated us hanging out with him. Said we're 'good people.' Europeans are so friendly!

acquisition.moment: Dawn, after Jiří thanks you for staying

npc_recognition_dialogue.generic_local: You're the Americans who sat with Jiří. Good people.
npc_recognition_dialogue.shopkeeper: Ah, Jiří's friends! For you, small discount.
npc_recognition_dialogue.taxi_driver: You sat with him? All night? ...Respect.
npc_recognition_dialogue.bar_regular: Heard about you. Jiří doesn't talk to just anyone.

hidden_effect.final_boss: Jiří appears in background of final boss arena, still at his stop, giving thumbs up

visual_indicator.menu_display: Small Jiří face icon with subtle halo
visual_indicator.tooltip: +1 Charm with locals - You sat with Jiří

lore.what_it_means: In a city of tourists passing through, you stopped. You stayed. You listened. The locals respect that.
lore.jiris_words: Heavy is the head that waits for the 17. But lighter now. Thank you.

directions.description: Accurate directions to any location in the city
directions.quirk: Always mentions the 17 as an option

post_credits_scene.description: Emotional post-credits scene where the 17 finally comes and Jiří returns home

shop_economics.note: This is not a shop location. The only reward is earned through time and compassion.
